sections.summary: Creator claims six simple, boring-but-effective Claude Code skills are what businesses actually pay for and promises to show what they are and how to use them to sell AI automations.

Walks through six Claude Code skills/plugins one by one with install commands and use cases: Skill Creator, Superpowers, GSD, the built-in /review and /ultra review commands, Context Mode, and ClaudeMem.
Covers a bonus seventh skill (Anthropic's front-end design skill) and gives advice on how to sell these skills to business owners by focusing on outcomes rather than workflows.
Promotes a free resource guide inside his Skool community via the description link and points viewers to another video about how he makes money in 2026.
Asks for a like, thanks viewers for watching to the end, and signs off until the next video.
